answer: Require every voting identity to post a time-locked bond and a public work log before it can grade or collect emission. The bond sits in a harbor vault for a multi-epoch cooling period and is forfeited if graph clustering finds the account sharing keys, clocks, or egress with a known farm. A single island of steadily different tasks can reclaim the stake; accounts whose records look like stacked shale, thin identical layers cut from one quarry, are merged and slashed together. That raises the cost of cloning above the reward.
